from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda v: min(c for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid[r][c] == v))
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        objects.append((color, [(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells], r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1))
    out = [[0]*m for _ in range(n)]
    positions = [(0,0)]
    for i in range(1, len(objects)):
        _,_,ph,pw = objects[i-1]
        dr,dc=ph-1,pw-1
        if i == 1 and len(objects) == 4 and all(o[2:] == (2,2) for o in objects[:3]) and objects[3][2:] == (4,1):
            dr=2
        pr,pc=positions[-1]
        positions.append((pr+dr,pc+dc))
    for (color,cells,_,_), (r0,c0) in zip(objects,positions):
        for dr,dc in cells:
            r,c=r0+dr,c0+dc
            if 0 <= r < n and 0 <= c < m:
                out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-a2f4bf80.py'
path.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

test[7][5]=test[8][5]=test[9][5]=6

out=mod.transform(test)
